lead.event: Rupiah depreciation brings the currency to successive record lows
lead.headline: Rupiah hits a new record low of Rp18,254/US$
lead.blurb: It had reached Rp18,239/US$ on 12 November and closed at Rp18,206 on 13 November. The currency had depreciated 2.9% since 16 September and 8.51% year to date, while foreign net selling totaled about Rp97 trillion. Sucor Sekuritas' Hendry Wijaya cited rupiah weakness, foreign outflows, MSCI concerns and expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike as market pressures. Bank Indonesia's Board of Governors meets on 17–18 November, ahead of MSCI rebalancing at the 30 November close and the Fed's decision on 9 December.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The rupiah hit an all-time low of Rp18,254/US$ on 16 November 2026.

other.event: ULTJ sets cum date for additional Rp100 per share dividend
other.headline: ULTJ sets 16 November cum date for additional Rp100-per-share dividend
other.blurb: Ultrajaya’s additional Rp1 trillion cash dividend for fiscal 2025 was approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 6 November. It will be funded from unrestricted retained earnings, which stood at Rp7.5 trillion at year-end 2025; the company previously paid a final dividend of Rp130 per share on 22 May.

earnings_guidance.event: Astra International unveils its strategy and financial targets through 2030
earnings_guidance.headline: ASII unveils strategy with EPS target of Rp1,150–Rp1,200 through 2030
earnings_guidance.blurb: Astra’s earnings-per-share target excludes non-recurring items. It also targets minimum 15% ROE and annual total shareholder return in the low teens, will maintain a 45%–50% dividend payout policy, and plans to reallocate around Rp10 trillion in net assets by 2030.

earnings_guidance.event: Antam reports nine-month 2026 net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports nine-month net profit up 46% to Rp9.7 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Antam's revenue rose 23% to Rp88.48 trillion, with precious metals and refining contributing Rp68.8 trillion, about 78% of the total. Gold sales reached 25.2 tons worth Rp68.4 trillion, up 17%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Precious metals and refining contributed Rp68.8 trillion, about 78% of revenue.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset raises its target price and profit forecasts for Indo Tambangraya Megah
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset raises ITMG target price to Rp26,520 and profit forecasts
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas lifted its target from Rp25,000, implying 8.9% upside, and kept a hold recommendation on Indo Tambangraya Megah. It raised its net profit projections by 15.6% for 2026 and 5.9% for 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Tugu Insurance reports nine-month 2026 net profit growth of 17.4%
earnings_guidance.headline: TUGU reports 17.4% nine-month 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Tugu Insurance's net profit attributable to parent owners reached Rp495.15 billion, up from Rp421.75 billion a year earlier. January-September insurance service revenue rose 4.5% to Rp6.7 trillion, while expenses increased to Rp6.72 trillion from Rp6 trillion.

deals_control.event: Antam signals a minimum 50% FY2026 dividend payout and plans mining acquisitions
deals_control.headline: ANTM signals at least 50% FY2026 dividend payout and plans mining acquisitions
deals_control.blurb: Antam is considering increasing its 10% stake in Weda Bay Nickel, with final decisions resting with MIND ID, and awaits direction and an IUPK for Kristalin Ekalestari’s former Nabire gold concession. Stockbit estimates a potential dividend of Rp225–314 per share, equivalent to an 8–11.2% yield.

deals_control.event: Indokripto agrees to acquire a 10% stake in Mitra Informatika Gemilang for Rp200 billion
deals_control.headline: COIN signs conditional deal to acquire 10% of MIG for Rp200 billion
deals_control.blurb: The 13 November conditional share subscription agreement with Mitra Informatika Gemilang covers 1,223,435 new series B shares at Rp163,475 each. The data center and IT services provider operates Bitera in Jakarta’s Kuningan area, with capacity of more than 30 MG.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: MIG operates Bitera, a data center in Jakarta’s Kuningan area with capacity of more than 30 MG.

market_structure_policy.event: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks from its global indexes in the December review
market_structure_policy.headline: FTSE Russell removes 14 Indonesian stocks in December index review
market_structure_policy.blurb: FTSE Russell also extended its freeze on new Indonesian inclusions to March 2027, while retaining Indonesia’s Secondary Emerging Market classification and keeping it off its Watch List. All affected stocks are classified as high shareholding concentration. The changes take effect on 21 December, and the review results become final on 7 December.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: FTSE Russell extended its freeze on new Indonesian inclusions to March 2027.
